|game_text=Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your gametext on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. |errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-whereareyoutakingthem-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 7.2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Where_Are_You_Taking_Them.png]]); both show this text. The PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010): “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your gametext on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say “Coruscant?” and lose 1 Force to place a just-resolved Interrupt in owner's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 December 2010"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Where Are You Taking Them? (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “gametext” to “game text”, “just-resolved” to “just-played” and “owner's” to “owners”: “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your game text on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say 'Coruscant?' and lose 1 Force to place a just-played Interrupt in owners Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1272_7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
